solution:
Differentiate term by term, using \(\frac{d}{dx}x^{n} = nx^{n-1}\), \(\frac{d}{dx}e^{x} = e^{x}\) and \(\frac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{4}{3}x^{\frac{4}{3}-1} + e^{x} - \cos x\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{4}{3}x^{\frac{1}{3}} + e^{x} - \cos x\)

Write \(\sqrt{x} = x^{\frac{1}{2}}\) and differentiate term by term, using \(\frac{d}{dx}\tan x = \sec^{2} x\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{2}x^{-\frac{1}{2}} + \sec^{2} x - 3x^{2}\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} + \sec^{2} x - 3x^{2}\)

Write \(\frac{3}{x^{\frac{3}{2}}} = 3x^{-\frac{3}{2}}\), and use \(\frac{d}{dx}\operatorname{cosec} x = -\operatorname{cosec} x\cot x\) and \(\frac{d}{dx}a^{x} = a^{x}\log a\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{x} - \left(-\operatorname{cosec} x\cot x\right) + 5^{x}\log 5 - 3\left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)x^{-\frac{5}{2}}\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{x} + \operatorname{cosec} x\cot x + 5^{x}\log 5 + \frac{9}{2x^{\frac{5}{2}}}\)

Write \(\frac{5}{x^{\frac{2}{5}}} = 5x^{-\frac{2}{5}}\) and apply the power rule to each term.
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{7}{3}x^{\frac{4}{3}} + 5\cdot\frac{4}{5}x^{-\frac{1}{5}} - 5\left(-\frac{2}{5}\right)x^{-\frac{7}{5}}\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{7}{3}x^{\frac{4}{3}} + \frac{4}{x^{\frac{1}{5}}} + \frac{2}{x^{\frac{7}{5}}}\)

Write \(x\sqrt{x} = x^{\frac{3}{2}}\). Note \(7^{7}\) is a constant, so its derivative is \(0\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = 7^{x}\log 7 + 7x^{6} - \frac{2}{3}\cdot\frac{3}{2}x^{\frac{1}{2}} - \frac{1}{x} + 0\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = 7^{x}\log 7 + 7x^{6} - \sqrt{x} - \frac{1}{x}\)

Use \(\frac{d}{dx}\cot x = -\operatorname{cosec}^{2} x\) and write \(\frac{4}{x^{\frac{3}{4}}} = 4x^{-\frac{3}{4}}\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = 3\left(-\operatorname{cosec}^{2} x\right) - 5e^{x} + \frac{3}{x} - 4\left(-\frac{3}{4}\right)x^{-\frac{7}{4}}\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = -3\operatorname{cosec}^{2} x - 5e^{x} + \frac{3}{x} + \frac{3}{x^{\frac{7}{4}}}\)

Product rule with \(u = x^{5}\), \(v = \tan x\) : \(\frac{dy}{dx} = u\frac{dv}{dx} + v\frac{du}{dx}\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = x^{5}\sec^{2} x + \tan x\cdot 5x^{4}\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = x^{4}\left(x\sec^{2} x + 5\tan x\right)\)

Product rule with \(u = x^{3}\), \(v = \log x\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = x^{3}\cdot\frac{1}{x} + \log x\cdot 3x^{2} = x^{2} + 3x^{2}\log x\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = x^{2}\left(1 + 3\log x\right)\)

Product rule with \(u = (x^{2}+2)^{2}\), \(v = \sin x\), where \(\frac{du}{dx} = 2(x^{2}+2)\cdot 2x = 4x(x^{2}+2)\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = (x^{2}+2)^{2}\cos x + \sin x\cdot 4x(x^{2}+2)\)
Taking \((x^{2}+2)\) common,
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = (x^{2}+2)\left[(x^{2}+2)\cos x + 4x\sin x\right]\)

Product rule with \(u = e^{x}\), \(v = \log x\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x}\cdot\frac{1}{x} + \log x\cdot e^{x}\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x}\left(\frac{1}{x} + \log x\right)\)

Product rule for three factors, \(\frac{d}{dx}(uvw) = \frac{du}{dx}vw + u\frac{dv}{dx}w + uv\frac{dw}{dx}\), with \(u = x^{\frac{3}{2}}\), \(v = e^{x}\), \(w = \log x\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{3}{2}x^{\frac{1}{2}}e^{x}\log x + x^{\frac{3}{2}}e^{x}\log x + x^{\frac{3}{2}}e^{x}\cdot\frac{1}{x}\)
Taking \(\sqrt{x}\,e^{x}\) common,
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \sqrt{x}\,e^{x}\left[1 + x\log x + \frac{3}{2}\log x\right]\)

Here \(y\) is the product of \(\log e^{x^{3}}\) and \(\log x^{3}\). Simplify first: \(\log e^{x^{3}} = x^{3}\) and \(\log x^{3} = 3\log x\), so \(y = 3x^{3}\log x\).
Product rule with \(u = 3x^{3}\), \(v = \log x\) :
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = 3x^{3}\cdot\frac{1}{x} + \log x\cdot 9x^{2} = 3x^{2} + 9x^{2}\log x\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = 3x^{2}\left(1 + 3\log x\right)\)

\(x^{2}\sqrt{x} = x^{\frac{5}{2}}\), so differentiate that by the power rule and \(x^{4}\log x\) by the product rule.
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{5}{2}x^{\frac{3}{2}} + \left(x^{4}\cdot\frac{1}{x} + \log x\cdot 4x^{3}\right) = \frac{5}{2}x^{\frac{3}{2}} + x^{3} + 4x^{3}\log x\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{5}{2}x^{\frac{3}{2}} + x^{3}\left(1 + 4\log x\right)\)

Apply the product rule to each term.
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(e^{x}\sec x\right) = e^{x}\sec x\tan x + \sec x\cdot e^{x} = e^{x}\sec x(\tan x + 1)\)
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(x^{\frac{5}{3}}\log x\right) = x^{\frac{5}{3}}\cdot\frac{1}{x} + \log x\cdot\frac{5}{3}x^{\frac{2}{3}} = x^{\frac{2}{3}}\left(1 + \frac{5}{3}\log x\right)\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x}\sec x(\tan x + 1) - x^{\frac{2}{3}}\left(1 + \frac{5}{3}\log x\right)\)

Write \(x\sqrt{x} = x^{\frac{3}{2}}\); differentiate \(x^{4}\) by the power rule and the other two terms by the product rule.
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(x^{\frac{3}{2}}\cos x\right) = -x^{\frac{3}{2}}\sin x + \frac{3}{2}x^{\frac{1}{2}}\cos x\)
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(x^{2}e^{x}\right) = x^{2}e^{x} + 2xe^{x} = xe^{x}(x+2)\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = 4x^{3} - x^{\frac{3}{2}}\sin x + \frac{3}{2}\sqrt{x}\cos x - xe^{x}(x+2)\)

Apply the product rule to each of the three terms.
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left[(x^{3}-2)\tan x\right] = (x^{3}-2)\sec^{2} x + 3x^{2}\tan x\)
\(\frac{d}{dx}(x\cos x) = -x\sin x + \cos x\)
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(7^{x}\cdot x^{7}\right) = 7^{x}\log 7\cdot x^{7} + 7^{x}\cdot 7x^{6} = x^{6}\cdot 7^{x}\left(x\log 7 + 7\right)\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = (x^{3}-2)\sec^{2} x + 3x^{2}\tan x + x\sin x - \cos x + x^{6}\cdot 7^{x}\left(7 + x\log 7\right)\)

Apply the product rule to each of the three terms.
\(\frac{d}{dx}(\sin x\log x) = \sin x\cdot\frac{1}{x} + \cos x\log x = \frac{\sin x}{x} + \cos x\log x\)
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(e^{x}\cos x\right) = -e^{x}\sin x + e^{x}\cos x = e^{x}(-\sin x + \cos x)\)
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(e^{x}\sqrt{x}\right) = e^{x}\sqrt{x} + e^{x}\cdot\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} = e^{x}\left(\frac{1+2x}{2\sqrt{x}}\right)\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\sin x}{x} + \cos x\log x + e^{x}(-\sin x + \cos x) - e^{x}\left(\frac{1+2x}{2\sqrt{x}}\right)\)

Apply the product rule to each of the three terms.
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(e^{x}\tan x\right) = e^{x}\sec^{2} x + e^{x}\tan x = e^{x}\left(\sec^{2} x + \tan x\right)\)
\(\frac{d}{dx}(\cos x\log x) = \frac{\cos x}{x} - \sin x\log x\)
\(\frac{d}{dx}\left(\sqrt{x}\,5^{x}\right) = \frac{5^{x}}{2\sqrt{x}} + \sqrt{x}\,5^{x}\log 5 = 5^{x}\left(\frac{2x\log 5 + 1}{2\sqrt{x}}\right)\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = e^{x}\left(\sec^{2} x + \tan x\right) + \frac{\cos x}{x} - \sin x\log x - 5^{x}\left(\frac{2x\log 5 + 1}{2\sqrt{x}}\right)\)

Quotient rule with \(u = \sqrt{x}+5\), \(v = \sqrt{x}-5\), where \(\frac{du}{dx} = \frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{(\sqrt{x}-5)\cdot\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} - (\sqrt{x}+5)\cdot\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}}{(\sqrt{x}-5)^{2}} = \frac{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\left[(\sqrt{x}-5) - (\sqrt{x}+5)\right]}{(\sqrt{x}-5)^{2}}\)
\(= \frac{-10}{2\sqrt{x}(\sqrt{x}-5)^{2}}\)
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{5}{\sqrt{x}\left(\sqrt{x}-5\right)^{2}}\)

Quotient rule with \(u = xe^{x}\), \(v = x+e^{x}\), where \(\frac{du}{dx} = e^{x} + xe^{x} = e^{x}(1+x)\) and \(\frac{dv}{dx} = 1+e^{x}\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{(x+e^{x})e^{x}(1+x) - xe^{x}(1+e^{x})}{(x+e^{x})^{2}} = \frac{e^{x}\left[(x+e^{x})(1+x) - x(1+e^{x})\right]}{(x+e^{x})^{2}}\)
The bracket is \(x + x^{2} + e^{x} + xe^{x} - x - xe^{x} = x^{2} + e^{x}\).
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{e^{x}\left(x^{2}+e^{x}\right)}{(x+e^{x})^{2}}\)

Quotient rule with \(u = x\log x\), \(v = x+\log x\), where \(\frac{du}{dx} = 1 + \log x\) and \(\frac{dv}{dx} = 1 + \frac{1}{x}\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{(x+\log x)(1+\log x) - x\log x\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)}{(x+\log x)^{2}}\)
Numerator \(= x + x\log x + \log x + (\log x)^{2} - x\log x - \log x = x + (\log x)^{2}\).
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x + (\log x)^{2}}{(x+\log x)^{2}}\)

Quotient rule with \(u = x^{2}\sin x\), \(v = x+\cos x\), where \(\frac{du}{dx} = 2x\sin x + x^{2}\cos x\) and \(\frac{dv}{dx} = 1 - \sin x\).
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{(x+\cos x)\left(2x\sin x + x^{2}\cos x\right) - x^{2}\sin x(1-\sin x)}{(x+\cos x)^{2}}\)
Numerator \(= 2x^{2}\sin x + x^{3}\cos x + 2x\sin x\cos x + x^{2}\cos^{2} x - x^{2}\sin x + x^{2}\sin^{2} x\)
\(= x^{2}\sin x + x^{3}\cos x + x^{2} + x\sin 2x\), using \(\sin^{2} x + \cos^{2} x = 1\) and \(2\sin x\cos x = \sin 2x\).
\(\therefore \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x^{2}\left(1 + \sin x + x\cos x\right) + x\sin 2x}{(x+\cos x)^{2}}\)

\(f(x) = a\sin x - b\cos x\), so \(f'(x) = a\cos x + b\sin x\).
\(f'\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right) = \frac{a}{\sqrt{2}} + \frac{b}{\sqrt{2}} = \sqrt{2}\), i.e. \(a + b = 2\).
\(f'\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}a + \frac{1}{2}b = 2\), i.e. \(\sqrt{3}\,a + b = 4\).
Subtracting, \((\sqrt{3}-1)a = 2\), so \(a = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}-1} = \sqrt{3}+1\) and \(b = 2 - a = 1 - \sqrt{3}\).
\(\therefore f(x) = (\sqrt{3}+1)\sin x + (\sqrt{3}-1)\cos x\)
